ns2:section.sectionText: Online and Continuing Education (OCE) restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.oce.illinois.edu. Elluminate online synchronous class sessions will be held on Wednesdays from 5:30 - 6:50 pm. All lectures will be completely online and will be done asynchronously, at the student's convenience. Enrollment in this course section is restricted to non-residential, nondegree students only.
